pages.quiz:
MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody.

2. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.
   B. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.
   C. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Remove the need for rules

4. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.
   C. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.

5. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Dance.
   B. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Dance.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Dance.

6. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Songs.

7. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

8. Best practice when working on Singing games: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Singing games.
   B. Practise Singing games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Singing games.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Singing games.

9. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The ticket price
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the costume

10. Best practice when working on Elements of AND RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   B. Damage equipment used for Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   C. Practise Elements of AND RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Elements of AND RESPONDING.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Elements of AND RESPONDING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Singing games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. C — Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. C — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

4. C — Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. B — Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. A — Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. B — Red, blue, and yellow

8. B — Practise Singing games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. C — The speed of the music

10. C — Practise Elements of AND RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Melody; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

12. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Elements of AND RESPONDING; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Songs; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Singing games; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
